title: fixture_verdict
description: The fixture judge's answer (Implementation Decisions 12): whether one sample of a fixture's subject meets the fixture's rubric, judged by a fresh session with no tools from only the fields the fixture shows it.

verdict.description: pass when the fields meet the rubric, fail when they do not

reason.description: one paragraph: the rubric's words applied and the field that settled it; on a fail, each thing that fell short
